show.description: 💃💃💃 During Navratri in Ahmedabad, street vendor Sejal is betrayed by boyfriend Prateek who leaves her for cousin Nandini. Mysterious beggar Shivam proposes a fake marriage to fulfill her dying grandmother’s wish. As they grow closer, Sejal discovers Shivam is actually Shah Industries’ billionaire CEO who went undercover. Despite initial hurt over his deception, true love ultimately prevails and they marry.
